newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity adds two portfolios to sector fund lineup.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity adds two portfolios to sector fund lineup.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said on Monday it has added two new funds -- Fidelity Select Cyclical Industries Portfolio and Fidelity Select Natural Resources Portfolio, bringing to 254 the total number of funds offered by the mutual fund giant.

Fidelity Select Cyclical Industries Portfolio will invest mainly in equity securities of companies engaged in the research, development, manufacture, distribution, supply or sale of materials related to cyclical industries, it said.
The fund will be managed by Albert Ruback, 35, who also continues as manager of Fidelity Advisor Cyclical Industries Fund which was begun last September.

Fidelity Select Natural Resources Portfolio will invest mainly in equity securities of companies that own or develop natural resources or supply good and services to such firms. The fund will be managed by Larry Rakers, 34, who will continue as manager of Fidelity Select Paper and Forest Products Portfolio, Fidelity Select Energy Portfolio and Fidelity Advisor Natural Resources Fund.

Fidelity said the Select Paper and Forest Products Portfolio had a one-year performance ending December 1996 of 7.07 percent. The Select Energy Portfolio for the same time period had a 32.37 percent return and the Natural Resources fund had a 30.52 percent return. The benchmark S&P 500 had a 22.96 percent return for the same period.
Fidelity Select funds are sold directly to customers, while Fidelity Advisor funds are sold through brokers and third-parties.
As of December 31, 1996, Fidelity had total managed assets of $496.3 billion.
